I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492.** This is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting their door assignments by text. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the problem was gone. The digest also lists a follow-up for 6 Oct: make sure the Eau Claire kiosk logs were archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419.** This is in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

The two numbers look alike, and both involve Door 14, but Moss's notes don't say they're the same ticket. I've listed them separately. Since the cheat sheet has no date, I can't tell which is newer.

I looked through all six of Moss's notes in the team digest folders. The other four don't give a Quarrendon ticket number: the 9/14 pipeline digest, the 3/23 renewal note and the two Central notes. Tickets #4409 and #4412 and request FR-882 in the Central notes are for Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways," a different company that isn't our customer.
